text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Trainer-san's directory profile is...—
here it is.
...Huh? A rookie Trainer? —Ah, but...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(You used to serve as a sub-trainer.
Ah...
is that why you're so perceptive to our
subtle emotions?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...A sub-trainer's job is supporting the team,
after all.
They receive reports from the girls and
interact with them constantly.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Past track record—...is blank?
Umamusume trained—none.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I suppose that's just how it is for a
sub-trainer...

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut ...
text_block_list.text:
Aaaargh,
my legs gave out at the very end...!
Um, what part of my run went wrong?
choice_data_list: The direction of your push-off. Yo...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Oh,
wow. I couldn't tell at all just watching.
Both the analysis and the solution came so
naturally to them—)

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut ...
text_block_list.text:
So... like this?! —Whoa,
the propulsion feels completely different!
Ehehe,
I feel like I can beat my personal best like
this!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Earlier,
she was almost crushed under the weight of
defeat— and now,
she's smiling with overflowing
confidence.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—They really are an exceptional Trainer.
And yet—...
none of it shows up on their official
record—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Day of the Fukushima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—... She won! Oh, thank goodness—!
Ah, there's Trainer-san on screen. Hehehe,
looking so pleased.

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut ...
text_block_list.text:
"I hadn't been producing results at 2000m
and was unsure about today, 
but thanks to Trainer <username>,
I was able to win!"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed,
I was watching the broadcast.
It was a well-deserved victory!
Due to a losing streak,
she had developed a mental block, but—"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer <username> guided her through it!
No one else could have handled this.
I'm grateful from the bottom of my heart!"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer <username> guided her through it!
No one else could have handled this.
I'm grateful from the bottom of my heart!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To be trusted so deeply even by a senior
trainer—
They truly are a remarkable Trainer after
all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—I wonder if today's newspaper has arrived
yet.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—There it is.
Let's see,
yesterday's article on the Fukushima
Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――――No way...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(There isn't a single word about
Trainer-san...
Even though both she and the senior trainer
mentioned them in their comments—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
What about the fans who watched the
race...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Same as the papers...
nobody's really talking about them.
It can't be helped, 
but all their achievements remain hidden in
the senior trainer's shadow...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Even though they're such a wonderful
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
—All right, everyone,
that's three sets done.
We'll be clocking your times after a short
break!
There are trainers here scouting today,
so give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Trainer-san is here to scout...—ah.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, .
—Are you here to observe?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —U-Um...—is there s-something on my face?
choice_data_list: No... as long as you're doing well...
No... as long as you're doing well...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fine.
I've made up my mind to take my time 
thinking over the racing situation.
—Thank you for your concern, .

text_block_list.name: Team Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Sub-trai... Wait, Trainer!
Ah, are you in the middle of something?
...You look busy, never mind.
choice_data_list: Wait, I have enough time to talk t...

text_block_list.name: Team Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Then please,
give me a few minutes after training!
Sorry for interrupting! See you later!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Is that someone from your former team?
Hehe, you really are well-loved,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I think I understand why.
You're such a kind Trainer—
They must feel certain that you'll always
accept them.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(There are so many horsegirls who look up
to you. Trainer—
it wouldn't be strange if you received so
many more bouquets.)

text_block_list.name: Sub-Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, shoot!
I forgot today was the deadline for race
registration!! And of all times,
when the head trainer is on a business trip!
But training is about to—
choice_data_list: Should I watch over training for you?
Should I watch over training for you?

text_block_list.name: Sub-Trainer
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure...? Th-Then...
I'll take you up on that offer...
Here is today's menu! I'm so sorry,
and thank you!
choice_data_list: No need to panic. Just make sure t...
No need to panic. Just make sure t...

text_block_list.name: Head Trainer
text_block_list.text:
<username>,
aren't you taking on too much work?
You have the important task of finding your
own assigned horsegirl, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—If I remember correctly,
that's the chief trainer
from the team they belonged to as a
sub-trainer...)
choice_data_list: Yes, but the horsegirls are the on...

text_block_list.name: Head Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I understand that,
but you need to think about your own career
as well.

text_block_list.name: Head Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Putting the horsegirls first—
choice_data_list: Yes. It's the very first thing you...

text_block_list.name: Head Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes, that's right.
When you first joined our team,
I scolded you harshly, didn't I?
Telling you to always make horsegirls your
top priority.

text_block_list.name: Head Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see...
That's why you're always acting on their
behalf...
choice_data_list: I want to be a Trainer who does my...

text_block_list.name: Head Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you put it like that,
there's really nothing more I can say,
is there?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... What a truly warm person.
Constantly,
purely thinking of the horsegirls—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(That's why—
you didn't overlook even the slightest change
in me. Gently,
quietly—like a flower—
nestling close to my heart.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Treating my desire to run as something
precious, with utmost respect.
...There is no one as kind as this
Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(So why...
why must that radiance remain buried in
obscurity?
Why does no one sing their praises?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(A golden bouquet—
is what truly suits you.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...A bouquet.
The only ones who can deliver victory—
are the horsegirls.
—Only a horsegirl can present it.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (............In that case... —I will!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Would you... please become my Trainer...?!
